explication: TradingView MCP Bridge lets an AI assistant or terminal user inspect and control a locally running TradingView Desktop chart. Requests enter through MCP stdio tools or the JSON CLI, pass into domain-specific core modules, and execute JavaScript through a Chrome DevTools Protocol connection. Results return as structured JSON, screenshots, chart state, Pine diagnostics, or streaming JSONL. The graph preserves documented branches for analysis, Pine development, drawing, alerts, replay, panes, tabs, UI automation, and monitoring. Some unsampled domain wiring is shown only where registration and module structure support it.
